rules.message: A Saudi national cannot be onboarded on an expatriate path — a work visa, Iqama and work permit are for foreign nationals
The Saudi national path needs a Saudi nationality — an expatriate needs a visa or a Qiwa transfer
A new expatriate hire is recruited from outside the Kingdom — somebody already inside it is a Qiwa transfer
A Qiwa employee transfer moves somebody already working inside the Kingdom
